home.about.lead: In a world where music, technology and creativity meet, I am writing my own story. After many years of professional working life, I began creating my own works by combining my passion for music with the possibilities of artificial intelligence. In my songs I sometimes tell of love, sometimes of longing, and sometimes of real stories taken from life. Alongside this, I bring new ideas to life through video production, digital content creation and software projects. Ünal Büyüksungur Digital World is a reflection of my personal journey: a place where I share what I create and keep exploring and learning.

studio.faq.a01: Lyrics are written based on your story, and the music is produced with AI-assisted tools. Every stage, from lyrics to arrangement, is carefully guided by Ünal Büyüksungur. It is not mass production but a work made for your story alone.
studio.faq.q02: How soon will I receive my song?
studio.faq.a02: After your payment, you receive an appointment link by email and choose from the calendar when production starts. The first two song alternatives are delivered within 48 hours of the appointment start at the latest. After each revision request, new alternatives arrive within 6 working hours at the latest. If a delivery time falls on a weekend, it moves to Monday at the same time; for orders starting on a Thursday or Friday, you can receive your song at the weekend with the Hafta Sonu Teslim option. Time spent waiting for your feedback is not included in these periods.
studio.faq.q03: What is the difference between the two packages?
studio.faq.a03: Özel Şarkı (690 TL) includes 3 revisions, 8 alternatives in total and MP3 delivery. Özel Şarkı Plus (990 TL) includes 5 revisions, 12 alternatives in total and delivery as 320 kbps MP3 and WAV.
studio.faq.a04: A revision means sending all your change requests for the delivered alternatives together in a single message. Lyric corrections and changes to mood, tempo, vocals and arrangement are covered by revisions.
studio.faq.q05: What if I want to change the story completely?
studio.faq.a05: Requests that change the story, the subject or who the song is written for are not a revision but a new song. In that case, you can place a new order.
studio.faq.q06: Are there any extra charges along the way?
studio.faq.a06: No. The price you pay is the final price including all taxes; no extra fees are charged within your package's revisions.
studio.faq.q07: Can I see the lyrics in advance?
studio.faq.a07: Yes. If you tick this option on the order form, the lyrics are presented for your approval before the music is produced. Time spent waiting for your approval is not included in the delivery time.
studio.faq.q07n: Will names appear in the song?
studio.faq.a07na: Yes, if you wish. Because the lyrics are sung with Suno, an AI-assisted music tool, having names appear in the song requires entering the lyrics into this service abroad. That is why we ask separately for your explicit consent in the appointment form. Your story and contact details are not shared. If you do not consent, your song is written without names, using terms of address such as "my love" or "my dear mother". Details are in the Explicit Consent section of the
studio.faq.a08: The order form has a pronunciation note field where you can write how the names are pronounced. If a name is mispronounced, the correction is free and does not count against your revisions.
studio.faq.q09: In which languages and with which vocals are songs made?
studio.faq.a09: Songs are made in Turkish, English and German. You can choose a female vocal, a male vocal or "no preference".
studio.faq.a10c: features more than 70 works in different genres and moods.
studio.faq.q11: How will the song be delivered to me?
studio.faq.a11: It is sent by email as a download link. If you choose this on the order form, it is also delivered via WhatsApp. We recommend saving your files to your own device.
studio.faq.q12: Where can I use the song?
studio.faq.a12: The song is for your personal and private use: you can listen to it, share it with your loved ones, play it on special occasions and share it non-commercially on your personal social media accounts. Selling it, uploading it to music platforms and commercial use require permission.
studio.faq.q13: What if I don't like it?
studio.faq.a13: We use the revisions in your package to shape the song together until it is the way you want it. Because it is personalised content, no refunds are given for reasons of taste once production has started.
studio.faq.a14a: If you cancel before production starts, the full amount you paid is refunded. Details are in the
studio.faq.a15: Payments are processed through the Shopier payment infrastructure. Your card details never reach us and are not stored.
studio.faq.q16: Are my details and my story safe?
studio.faq.a16a: Your information is used only to prepare and deliver your song. It is not shared with anyone for marketing purposes; it is processed only with the service providers that supply the payment, appointment, email and music production infrastructure, and only to the extent the service requires (details in the
studio.faq.a16c: (in Turkish)). Your song is not published as a sample without your permission. Please do not write anything on the form that you do not want to appear in the song.

privacy.p1: This site has no forms that collect personal data. The site uses no cookies or analytics tools.
privacy.p2: Your language preference is stored only in your browser (localStorage); it is not sent to the server.
privacy.p3: On the work pages and the Music Studio pages, YouTube videos do not load until you press play; once you play a video, YouTube's (youtube-nocookie.com) privacy rules apply. The Perspective page loads its fonts from Google Fonts. Embedded YouTube content and external links (Spotify, Apple Music, Instagram, Shopier, Etsy, Blogspot, etc.) are subject to their own privacy policies.

video.importantText: The scenes feature only anonymous characters generated by AI. Photos are not accepted; real or well-known people are not depicted. Please do not include names or personal information in your clip description.
video.faq.a1: In the appointment form, you describe the clip's subject, setting, era, atmosphere and characters. Based on this description, scenes are written to fill the length of the song; each scene is generated separately with AI and combined with the song.
video.faq.a2: No. Clips are made without photos, using only anonymous characters generated by AI.
video.faq.q3: Can real or well-known people appear in the clip?
video.faq.a3: No. Scenes depicting real, well-known or specific people are not produced.
video.faq.a4: In the Song + Video packages, the clip is delivered within 72 hours at the latest after you approve your song; in the Video Clip package, within 72 hours at the latest from your appointment. If the deadline falls on a weekend, it moves to the same time on Monday.
video.faq.a5: Yes, once. Up to 3 scenes you don't like are regenerated. Changing the subject, setting or characters entirely is a new order.
video.faq.q6: Can I order a clip for my own song?
video.faq.a6: Yes, with the Video Clip package. In the appointment form, you share a link to your song and confirm that you hold the usage rights to it.
video.faq.q7: What format is the clip delivered in?
video.faq.a7: MP4, 1080p; landscape (YouTube, TV) or portrait (Instagram, TikTok), as you choose in the form.
video.faq.q8: Where can I share the clip?
video.faq.a8: The clip is licensed for personal, private use; you can share it with your loved ones and on your personal social media accounts. Commercial use requires permission.
